column31: THE ONLY RECORD IN THIS LEDGER THAT EARNS radiotrophic, and it earns it on growth contrasts, not damage or survival contrasts: CFU ~2.5x at 18/23/30 h (P = 0.006), 14C-acetate incorporation ~3x, dry weight +6.5% (C. neoformans, P = 0.02) and +8-10% (W. dermatitidis, P = 0.02); colony diameter and radial growth rate for C. sphaerospermum with a tricyclazole contrast. Melanin carried a BASELINE COST in the same experiment — non-irradiated Lac- cells grew better and incorporated more 14C-acetate than non-irradiated melanized cells — so the melanized-versus-albino comparison under radiation is confounded by a difference already present without radiation. column2: Melanin content of Cryptococcus neoformans grown on L-dopa
column15: defined minimal medium; 1.0 mM L-dopa; 10 d
column31: The one melanin mass fraction located for a modelled species: melanin comprised 15.4% of the dry mass of the cell after 10 days. IT IS NOT A SPECIES CONSTANT, on four grounds measured inside the same paper — strain (up to eightfold spread across seven strains; H99, the strain in both GEO deposits, was not profiled), precursor (relative content 0.05 catechol / 0.45 dopamine / 1.0 L-dopa), duration and temperature (melanization slower at 37 C, converging only by day 14, so a day-10 value sits on a rising curve), and medium (a maximal-melanization laboratory condition, not the nutrient state of any biofilm). And a fifth, on basis: 15.4% is lyophilized-ghost over lyophilized-whole-cell mass, a DRY-CELL quantity, while the contract requires hydrated_bulk_biofilm on a wet_bulk basis and no w_water exists for this system. PMC174092 is a scanned page image and both PDF endpoints returned HTML bot-walls, so the 153 mg / 994.7 mg mass pair and the CHN percentages are recorded as UNVERIFIED.

column2: Cultivation of the dematiaceous fungus Cladosporium sphaerospermum aboard the International Space Station
column9: uncharacterised; authors attribute trapped-belt electrons of hundreds of keV and protons above 100 MeV
column13: ISS cabin; PIN photodiode sensor pair above and below a Petri dish
column14: none — PIN photodiode count rate only
column23: n=1 dish (flight arm; no replication of the flight arm)
column31: THE FLAGSHIP RECORD BEHIND THE WORD 'RADIOTROPHIC' IN THIS REPOSITORY, AND IT EARNS NO PHENOTYPE AT ALL. (1) No dose axis exists — verbatim, 'Due to the nature of the employed radiation sensors (PIN photodiode), dosimetric data was not obtained'; two mutually inconsistent count-to-dose conversions appear in the supplement (~2.2 nGy per count; ~0.5 nGy per CPM), differing by 4.4x, and both divide someone else's whole-body dose rate by this detector's count rate. (2) The shielding result is not significant: 147 vs 151 CPM, phase 1 p = 0.970 (a proper negative control), phase 3 p = 0.069, n = 1 dish, one sensor pair, no attenuation coefficient, no areal density, and the attenuation path is dominated by 13.33 mm of agar. (3) The growth comparison is flight versus ground with microgravity, transit history and temperature regime confounded — the authors say so. (4) Melanin was NEVER measured: 'presumably constant', 'putatively'. (5) PEER REVIEW REMOVED THE CLAIM — every supplement page header still reads 'A Self-Replicating Radiation-Shield ... Radiotrophic Fungi can Attenuate Ionizing Radiation', while the published title reads 'Cultivation of the Dematiaceous Fungus...'. (6) The headline 1.21 +/- 0.37-fold does not reproduce internally against the supplement's 1.64-fold logistic-slope figure or the article's own rate constants, and does not exclude unity. INCOMPATIBLE on modality: a photon-only model cannot represent this field, and reconciling it is a stop condition. The analysis code at github.com/chkern/space-radiation is genuinely useful for the supplement's sheet structure and its _n/_nt NOISE CHANNELS, but its licence field is null and it pins no data version — not citable; if ever used, pin a commit SHA.

One blocker remains and it is the dose-gradient characterisation: whether the gradient at the growth front was measured or calculated is unknown, and the source geometry and activity are unstated. status is unsupported_by_current_model rather than blocked because even a perfect answer would not enter the model: a CPM cell ID is an isotropic biomass parcel with no elongation or connectivity term. column2: Aspergillus niger spores are highly resistant to space radiation
column9: 200 kV unfiltered bremsstrahlung (no filter; effective energy not stated); 150 MeV/n He LET 2.2; 500 MeV/n Fe LET 200; UV-C 254 nm
column10: LD90 N402 366 Gy X-ray / 506 Gy He / 112 Gy Fe
column31: radiotrophic REFUSED: no growth, biomass or metabolic measurement was made UNDER irradiation. That is an absence of measurement, not a measured null. growth_data is false — LD90 by CFU is an inactivation endpoint. THE ISOGENIC PIGMENT NULL IS THE FINDING: MA93.1 (delta fwnA) gives 353 / 567 / 112 Gy against N402's 366 / 506 / 112, indistinguishable and with the helium pair running the WRONG WAY; verbatim, 'deficiency in pigmentation did not alter survivability after exposure to ionizing radiation (X-rays or cosmic radiation)'. What does carry resistance is DNA repair: the NHEJ mutant collapses to 57 / 55 / 50 Gy, a roughly sixfold drop (inference, labelled). This REFUTES two in-repo claims: preprint/modeling_radiotrophic_fitness.md:31 ('confers substantial radioprotection') and :178 (alpha_M = 0.03-0.10 ug/cell/Gy, for which no located measurement exists and whose per-cell basis the CPM entity semantics do not admit). The UV-C arm, where a ~2x pigment effect appears, is confounded by the NHEJ mutant dropping to 580 J/m2 with no pigment defect — and UV-C is not ionizing radiation for this project regardless; the same paper's crystal-violet biofilm arm runs the other way entirely (81% reduction for wild type against 97% for the pigment mutant). The X-ray arm cannot be pooled with the ion arms without a modality collapse, and its tube spectrum is uncharacterised.

Chitin was assayed from 4 mg (+/- 0.5) of CELL WALL EXTRACTED from ~50 mg freeze-dried biomass; glucan from 5 mg (+/- 0.5) of freeze-dried, ground WHOLE BIOMASS — confirmed by the deposit's own Sample weight [mg] rows (3.5-4.5 mg against 4.6-5.5 mg). Converting to a dry-cell basis needs the wall-to-cell dry mass ratio and converting to hydrated bulk needs w_water; NEITHER IS MEASURED in the deposit, the thesis or the peer-reviewed companion, and NO CONVERSION WAS PERFORMED. Cell wall is not dry cell is not hydrated bulk.

column2: Wet and dry masses of Aspergillus niger colonies under simulated microgravity
column31: THE CLOSEST ANY PUBLIC SOURCE COMES TO A WATER MASS FRACTION FOR A MODELLED SPECIES, AND IT FAILS ON THE BLANK. Verbatim: 'each colony-carrying filter, of each biological replicate (n = 3), was recovered and placed inside a pre-weighted aluminum paper. The weight of the aluminum with a colony was measured before (wet weight = ww) and after desiccation (dry weight = dw) for 24 h at 60 C.' The weighed object is aluminium plus filter plus colony, so deriving w_water needs the aluminium tare AND the filter's own retained water — a stronger obstruction than a single missing blank. No hydrated volume was measured; mycelium thickness of 59 +/- 1 um is a thickness, not a volume. No surface-water removal protocol is documented. Author contact #2 wants the per-replicate masses, the tare, and a matched abiotic filter blank under the same protocol: w_water needs no volume, only masses and a blank. It would still not yield a density.

column15: isolation_source: soil around Kakrapar Atomic Power Station; country India: Surat
column31: THE ENTIRE PUBLIC FOOTPRINT OF THIS STRAIN IS 1086 BASE PAIRS AND ONE PAYWALLED ABSTRACT. Zero genomes, BioSamples, SRA runs, proteomes, transcriptomes, images or deposited datasets; no culture-collection accession was located, so whether the strain is obtainable at all is UNVERIFIED — and an unobtainable strain is a campaign-design problem, not a data problem. AN ISOLATION SOURCE IS NOT AN EXPOSURE: the only radiation connection this strain has is the soil it came from. TAXONOMY, RECORDED AND NOT COLLAPSED: NCBI taxid 94625 is now served as Brucella intermedia in the Brucella/Ochrobactrum group with Ochrobactrum intermedium retained as a synonym, and the reclassification is actively contested (10.1128/jcm.00438-23). Both names must travel together, as the Wangiella/Exophiala mapping does. This audit assigns NO RISK GROUP — that determination belongs to the institutional biosafety committee and must precede culturing — but it records that the containment driver named in data/calibration/baseline_condition.csv may not be C. neoformans.

column2: Thorium tolerance and EPS production of Ochrobactrum intermedium AM7
column31: REJECTED AS RADIATION EVIDENCE. Thorium tolerance is CHEMICAL-TOXICITY tolerance to a metal salt: no dose, no dose rate and no dosimetry was reported, and EPS yield was unchanged under Th. Whether the self-dose from Th-232 at that concentration over a culture period is negligible was NOT COMPUTED in this audit, and the conclusion does not require it. OpenAlex: is_oa false, any_repository_has_fulltext false, best_oa_location null; cited 36 times with no follow-up work on AM7 by any group in six years. Author contact #6 wants a culture-collection accession or a strain transfer, the EPS yield with its basis stated, the RSM run table with replicate structure, and any Th binding capacity in mg/g — and the biosafety item above comes first.

column2: Search for any ionizing-radiation exposure of Ochrobactrum intermedium AM7
column31: NO CANDIDATE FOUND. AM7 has NEVER been exposed to ionizing radiation in any public experiment located here. NCBI nuccore/biosample/sra/gene/assembly returned 1/0/0/0/0 for the strain; 96 assemblies exist for taxid 94625 and none is AM7. This is a search result on one date, not a proof of absence — and it is enough to conclude that the AM7 arm of any campaign must be designed rather than retrieved.

column2: Metal phenotypes of Ochrobactrum intermedium strains other than AM7
column5: SDCr-5; BCR400; BB12; CN3; MZV101; D-2; 96 assemblies for taxid 94625 (reference NCTC12171)
column31: REJECTED ON STRAIN. These are real, quantified metal phenotypes — Cr(VI) reduction, Cd tolerance — in the same species, from different environments with different EPS. AM7's distinguishing claim is exceptional EPS production and thorium tolerance, and nothing licenses transferring a chromate-reductase phenotype from a tannery isolate to it. 'Do not collapse related species' applies a fortiori WITHIN a species.

column2: Providencia thoriotolerans AM3 from the same isolation campaign as AM7
column31: REJECTED ON GENUS. Same laboratory, same isolation campaign, wrong organism. Read only for what it reveals about the AM7 methods, which is the useful part: the group's panel is EPS yield in g% w/v, viscosity, flocculating activity, carbohydrate and protein in g% w/v, FTIR, and ICP-OES ON SOIL. No dry weight, no XPS, no TEM-EDX, no thorium binding capacity in mg/g — and, like AM7, a single 16S accession as its entire deposit. Expect the same gaps from any AM7 author request.

column2: Confocal imaging of a recombinant biofilm-forming Deinococcus radiodurans derivative
column5: recombinant R1 derivative carrying gfp and kanR
column31: NO IONIZING RADIATION WAS APPLIED, so no radiation phenotype is assigned. The species' radioresistance is established elsewhere in the literature; it is NOT established by anything catalogued in this audit, and the label is not imported on reputation — that is the whole point of this row. The abstract states verbatim: 'Deinococcus radiodurans R1 is known as a nonbiofilm former bacterium.' The imaged organism is a RECOMBINANT derivative, so even the morphology is not wild-type morphology. A rendered confocal figure in a paper is not a raw 3D dataset; no image deposit exists.

column2: Uranium biosorption against Deinococcus radiodurans biofilm dry mass
column5: not named in the abstract (DR1-bf+ is an inference from the 2019 companion)
column31: THE ONLY RECORD IN THE AUDIT USING BIOFILM DRY MASS AS AN INDEPENDENT VARIABLE, and it fails on basis: a sorption capacity is metal mass per DRY biomass, with no water fraction to convert it, no closed elemental set, and no metal-free control biofilm characterised the same way. XRD indicates uranyl phosphate deposits. NOTHING WAS IRRADIATED — uranium is a chemical sorbate here. Author contact #8 wants the strain, the dry-mass values with the blank protocol, and whether a uranium-free control was characterised identically.

column2: Cryo-EM movies of Deinococcus radiodurans BamA
column31: REJECTED ON SCALE. Exact species in name only: this is a purified membrane protein, single-particle cryo-EM. It is the single hit returned by an EBI BioImage Archive query for Deinococcus, which is why it is recorded rather than silently dropped.

column2: Deinococcus radiodurans protein crystallography deposits
column31: REJECTED ON MODALITY AND SUBJECT. X-ray DIFFRACTION images from purified protein crystals; the X-rays are a structural probe, not an exposure, and there is no organism in the data. Recorded because a keyword search for 'Deinococcus' plus 'X-ray' returns these and a later pass would otherwise re-derive the rejection.

column2: Deinococcus radiodurans liquid-cell electron microscopy
column31: REJECTED ON SCALE, not on quality — same candidate as spatial/dataset_candidates.csv row dradiodurans_zenodo_em, id kept parallel. Its subject is cell ultrastructure in graphene liquid cells, not bulk biofilm architecture, and a parcel is a coarse biomass unit: no coarse-graining of ultrastructure answers the pitch question.

column2: Search for volumetric Deinococcus radiodurans biofilm imaging
column31: NO CANDIDATE FOUND across Dryad, Zenodo, BioImage Archive, BioStudies, EMPIAR, IDR, OSF, Figshare and PubMed. THE D. RADIODURANS ARM OF ANY SPATIAL CAMPAIGN HAS NO PUBLIC FALLBACK AND MUST BE ACQUIRED. Together with the AM7 row, that is two of the seven species with no usable public record of any kind.

column2: Transcriptome of melanized and non-melanized Exophiala dermatitidis under gamma radiation
column15: culture age and density identified as dominant confounders
column31: SURROGATE: E. dermatitidis is not one of the seven, and surrogate status is enforced, not conventional — no result here transfers to a modelled species as a phenotype. Its value is the ISOGENIC MELANIN-NULL CONTRAST the seven do not have. Verbatim: 'We find that melanin does not protect E. dermatitidis from gamma-radiation.' The same study identifies what DOES dominate: 'environmental factors such as nutrient availability, culture age and culture density are much greater determinants of cell survival after exposure' than melanin — a standing confounder warning, since a melanin effect measured without controlling culture age and density is not interpretable.

column2: Survival of melanized and non-melanized Exophiala dermatitidis under alpha particles protons and deuterons
column31: Verbatim: 'No significant difference in survival was observed between these strains under any condition, suggesting that melanin does not impart protection to acute irradiation to these particles.' Fitted alpha: wild type 6.38 kGy-1 (95% CI 0.26, 16.51) against pks 2.10 kGy-1 (95% CI 0.01, 10.04) — INTERVALS OVERLAPPING ACROSS ALMOST THEIR ENTIRE RANGE, which is what a null looks like when it is reported honestly. Charged particles, so nothing here can enter a photon transport comparison.

column2: Experimental evolution of ionizing-radiation resistance in melanized and non-melanized Exophiala dermatitidis
column12: ~4 and ~32 min at the stated rate
column31: Verbatim: 'melanin did not directly affect survival after gamma radiation exposure'. MELANIN CHANGES WHICH MECHANISM DOMINATES, NOT HOW MUCH PROTECTION THERE IS: constitutive DNA-repair expression evolved in melanized lines, redox-homeostasis upregulation in non-melanized ones. The one place melanin measurably mattered was MUTATION ACCUMULATION, NOT SURVIVAL — 'melanized lines that evolved to exhibit higher ionizing radiation resistance experienced fewer mutations, whereas similarly evolved, non-melanized lines accumulated more mutations'. An effect on damage with no effect on survival must not be generalised into a survival term, and it is direct evidence that a single scalar melanin coefficient is the wrong functional form. The study deposits no sequence data of its own; PRJNA224192 is correctly cited as the reference transcriptome, not as its reads.

column2: Melanin protection of Cryptococcus neoformans and Cryomyces antarcticus under deuterons and X-rays
column5: melanized and non-melanized arms of each
column9: deuterons; X-rays with no stated effective energy
column31: THE COUNTERWEIGHT, RETAINED DELIBERATELY BECAUSE IT POINTS THE OTHER WAY, and it is the one record in the audit where melanin measurably alters survival under an ionizing modality. Verbatim: 'Melanin afforded protection against high-dose (1.5 kGy) deuterons for both CN and CA (p-values < 10-4). For X-rays (0.3 kGy), melanin protected CA (p-values < 10-4) and probably CN.' Three internal contradictions worth more than the headline: (1) MODALITY DEPENDENCE — protection is firm for deuterons but for X-rays it is firm only in C. antarcticus and merely 'probably' in C. neoformans, so melanin protection is NOT ESTABLISHED FOR SPARSELY-IONIZING PHOTONS in the one species here that is also one of the seven; a hedge in an abstract is not a measurement. (2) OPPOSITE-SIGN METABOLIC READOUTS — deuterons increased XTT activity in melanized strains while ATP DECREASED in the same cells, so 'melanin protects metabolism' is not a coherent single claim. (3) CHEMISTRY DEPENDENCE — induced DOPA-melanin against constitutive DHN-melanin; 'melanin' is not one variable across the two arms. Paywalled, so the C. neoformans arm cannot be read at replicate level.

column2: Pigmentation and growth of environmental fungi under a characterised 137Cs field
column5: Sandia National Laboratories environmental isolates (no culture-collection accession)
column10: 0.5-1 Gy total; intra-colony gradient 85.2 rad at the central plug to 6.1 rad at the growing edge
column13: ~350 uCi 137Cs source at a stated stand-off
column14: MicroShield point-kernel modelling spot-validated by two TLD readings
column31: THE ONLY MEASURED PHOTON DOSE GRADIENT LOCATED ANYWHERE IN THE AUDIT — a 14-fold variation across a single colony — AND IT STILL IS NOT A BENCHMARK. The gradient is point-kernel MODELLING spot-validated by two TLDs, ONE OF WHICH DISAGREED WITH THE MODEL BY A FACTOR OF TWO (~100 rad measured against ~50 rad predicted); the total dose is three to four orders of magnitude below every other ionizing record here; and the biological observable is colony diameter, an AREAL growth measurement, which cannot identify a directional term. PIGMENTATION MOVES IN THE WRONG DIRECTION: under UV it increased, under gamma it DECREASED, both at P < 0.001 in both species, and growth rate did not change under gamma at all (P = 0.255 and P = 0.615). The authors note the result 'contrasts prior reports that suggest melanin provides enhanced protection against gamma irradiation.' melanin_data is true only as mean grey value, an optical proxy on an image. SPECIES: C. cladosporioides is NOT C. sphaerospermum. The replicate count is not stated — a P-value without an n cannot be propagated — and the isolates have no accession, so they are neither obtainable nor re-identifiable.

column2: Melanin versus cellulose beta-radiation transmission measurements and Geant4 applications
column9: 90Sr beta (electrons); a 40 kVp X-ray case exists in simulation only and was never measured
column13: 90Sr source with detector; cellulose control of matched elemental composition
column31: THE ONLY MEASURED TRANSMITTED-RADIATION DATA IN THE WHOLE AUDIT, AND ITS RESULT IS A NULL: 'melanin does not provide improved shielding in comparison to cellulose from beta-radiation.' radiation_shielding REFUSED — the term requires transmitted radiation reduced BY BIOMASS, and there is no biomass and no melanin-specific reduction. That is the physically expected outcome if attenuation is governed by areal density and Z, and it strips melanin of any special shielding status absent a spatial-arrangement argument; the paper's own positive finding, that thin films and hollow microspheres could matter in Monte Carlo, is a GEOMETRY claim, not a chemistry claim. LIMITS ON ITS USE AS A VALIDATION: it is beta (electrons), not photons; the comparison engine is Geant4, not OpenMC; agreement would license the statement 'the transport-comparison workflow was exercised' and NOTHING STRONGER.

column2: Radiosynthesis in melanized fungi: an energy-budget critique
column31: MINDS@UW thesis (UW-La Crosse, advisor Volk). Concludes that radiosynthesis has not been demonstrated, on two grounds: 'the energy deposited in their irradiated systems was too low to show the amount of growth seen, and the carbon sources provided in the media were sufficient to support the observed growth.' A CLOSED-BUDGET ARGUMENT — the same discipline this repository applies to mass fractions, applied to energy — plus a confounder argument. It contains NO NEW MEASUREMENT, so its evidence basis is derived and it is the negative side of an open dispute, not a verdict: 'not demonstrated' is not 'disproved'. The licence is not specified in the record, which is recorded rather than assumed.

column2: DHN melanin function across two rock-inhabiting black fungi
column23: n >= 9 (the best-replicated record in the audit)
column31: REJECTED ON MODALITY — UV-B, so nothing transfers to the ionizing case, and no phenotype from this ledger's vocabulary is earned. THE STRUCTURAL FINDING DOES TRANSFER AND IS THE REASON THE ROW EXISTS: the same pigment knocked out by the same gene class in two black fungi gives opposite results — 'DHN melanin provided UV-B protection in C. antarcticus, whereas the same pigment or even carotenoids proved ineffective in K. petricola', concluding that 'although the adaptive trait of DHN melanization commonly occurs across black fungi, it is not equally functional.' A PER-SPECIES MELANIN CONSTANT DERIVED FROM A DIFFERENT SPECIES IS NOT DEFENSIBLE EVEN BETWEEN TWO BLACK FUNGI. Independent support for the standing prohibition in biofilm_material_calibration.md section 1: do not create seven materials because there are seven species. Carries its own confounder: C. antarcticus tolerated higher UV-B but was sensitive to white light, and K. petricola showed the opposite trend.

column2: UV and visible-light records rejected as radiation evidence
column4: various (including Cladosporium sphaerospermum; Aspergillus niger; Cryptococcus neoformans; Deinococcus radiodurans)
column31: REJECTED ON MODALITY, EN BLOC. C. sphaerospermum wavelength-dependent UV survival (PMID 41183924), accumulated-melanin UV tolerance (PMID 39287919), A. niger pyomelanin UV-C shielding, the Evolution Canyon UV-A adaptive melanin response (10.1371/journal.pone.0002993), C. neoformans biofilm resistance to heat cold and UV light (10.1128/AEM.02506-06), the D. radiodurans UV-C stress panel (10.3390/ijms25010421), and pulsed-light pigmentation. UV IS NOT IONIZING RADIATION FOR THIS PROJECT: retaining any of them as radiation evidence would let a UV protection result be read as radioresistance, and any pigmentation-versus-dose relation imported from a UV study would carry THE WRONG SIGN applied to gamma. The Evolution Canyon paper fails a second time on basis — melanin quantified as absorbance at 420 nm in Soluene-350 PER 10^6 CELLS, an optical readout on a cell-count basis with no mass denominator, with isolates identified on morphology alone that the authors concede 'could be heterogeneous and perhaps consist of molecularly different species'.

column2: Light-regulated genes in Cryptococcus deneoformans
column31: REJECTED TWICE OVER. Visible light is not radiation evidence for this project, and the taxon is C. deneoformans JEC21, serotype D — A SEPARATE SPECIES from C. neoformans var. grubii, which is the modelled organism. Recorded because a GEO query for Cryptococcus plus radiation returns it.

column2: Proton irradiation of Aspergillus nidulans with oxidative pretreatment
column9: protons; fluence 1/2/5 x 10^10 p cm-2; accumulated charge 3200/6400/16000 +/- 20% pC
column10: no absorbed dose in Gy reported anywhere
column15: MSB oxidative pretreatment before or after irradiation
column31: REJECTED ON SPECIES — same genus as A. niger, not the same species, and not melanized. RETAINED FOR ONE STRUCTURAL FINDING: MSB oxidative pretreatment BEFORE irradiation increased tolerance while irradiation BEFORE MSB decreased it. THE SAME TWO STRESSORS IN OPPOSITE ORDER GIVE OPPOSITE OUTCOMES, which no dose-only scalar term can represent — an argument about functional form, not about a number. It also cannot be placed on the axis every other record uses, because it reports fluence and accumulated charge and NO ABSORBED DOSE IN GY ANYWHERE.

column2: MARSBOx stratospheric balloon exposure of Aspergillus niger
column9: UV 1148 kJ/m2 over 280-400 nm plus a negligible ionizing component
column31: REJECTED ON MODALITY, and the numbers are why: the total mission ionizing dose was 20.9 uGy, which the authors equate to roughly ten days of natural background and which is SEVEN ORDERS OF MAGNITUDE below the doses in the same group's X-ray and ion study. The observed 2-log survival reduction is a UV effect. Calling this a mixed-space-radiation validation would attribute a UV result to an ionizing field.

column2: Melanin-PLA biocomposites exposed in low Earth orbit
column9: uncharacterised; confounded with atomic oxygen and thermal cycling
column31: REJECTED. The measured outcome is polymer mass loss and surface wrinkling — DEGRADATION OF A PLASTIC, not transmitted radiation reduced by biomass, so it cannot earn radiation_shielding. The material is a dry engineered composite, not a hydrated biofilm, so it cannot inform a hydrated_bulk_biofilm composition either. The exposure is confounded with atomic-oxygen erosion and thermal cycling, which the abstract itself names as co-acting mechanisms.

column2: Superseded ISS preprint: a self-replicating radiation shield
column31: REJECTED AS SUPERSEDED. The peer-reviewed article deliberately removed both 'radiotrophic' and the shielding claim from the title, and reports 147 against 151 CPM rather than any percentage. THE WIDELY-QUOTED ATTENUATION FIGURE EXISTS IN NO VERSION: v1 says 2.17 +/- 0.35%, v7 says approximately 0.84%, the published article says neither, and the commonly cited '2.17 +/- 0.25%' is a MIS-TRANSCRIPTION of a superseded preprint. Quoting it would cite a withdrawn framing over the published one. bioRxiv landing pages and PDFs returned HTTP 403 and were not retried; abstracts were read from independent mirrors and every value is marked unverified at source.

column2: ResearchGate figure pages for Cryptococcus neoformans B3501 biofilm confocal images
column31: REJECTED ON DATA AVAILABILITY, and this is THE SINGLE THING MOST LIKELY TO BE MISTAKEN FOR THE MISSING VOLUMETRIC DATA. Extracted figure images on an aggregator: no manifest, no voxel calibration, no licence, no persistent identifier. Recorded explicitly so that a later pass recognises it on sight.

column2: Aspergillus niger biofilm CLSM and COMSTAT biovolume papers
column24: none deposited (rendered figures and derived scalars)
column31: REJECTED ON DATA AVAILABILITY. Exactly the right modality — confocal z-stacks with biovolume quantification — and NO RAW STACKS DEPOSITED ANYWHERE FINDABLE. What is published is rendered figures and derived biovolume-per-area scalars, which cannot be re-segmented, carry no voxel calibration, and cannot select a pitch. An open-access article is not an available dataset.

column2: EPS-mediated U(VI) immobilisation by Shewanella sp. HRCR-1
column31: REJECTED ON SPECIES AND ON AVAILABILITY. HRCR-1 is an environmental isolate, not S. oneidensis MR-1, and the ACS figshare collection holds exactly one item, a supporting-information PDF; the PNNL Datahub node and the OSTI record are bibliographic only.

column2: NASA OSDR omics records for modelled species
column31: REJECTED ON REPRESENTATIONAL GROUNDS. Genomes, proteomes and transcriptomes, including 91 Shewanella records: A TRANSCRIPTOME ALONE DOES NOT DEFINE A CPM SCALE PARAMETER AND A PROTEOME ALONE DOES NOT DEFINE AN OpenMC MATERIAL. The ISS A. niger isolate's exposure history is uncontrolled and uncharacterised, so even the qualitative radiation framing is not a dose-response. A search for Cladosporium in OSDR returned 6 studies and NONE of them is the ISS radiation experiment.

column2: Quantitative modelling of microbial population responses to chronic irradiation
column31: REJECTED ON EVIDENCE BASIS. A modelling synthesis over other people's data: under the repository's evidence hierarchy it is at best 'derived', which sits in BLOCKED_EVIDENCE, so nothing in it can be exported as a calibrated quantity and importing a number from it would launder a synthesis into a measurement.

column2: Self-deposited Zenodo documents proposing melanin radiation mechanisms
column26: GPL-3.0 on the PDF; unverified on the HTML
column31: REJECTED. A 3.6 kB self-deposited HTML document proposing a melanin quantum-spin mechanism, and a self-deposited essay licensed GPL-3.0 on a PDF. No data, no method, no peer review. A RESOLVING DOI IS NOT EVIDENCE — recorded because both surface in a Zenodo query for melanin and radiation and both would otherwise be re-triaged.

column2: Attractive density and composition numbers located and refused
column31: THREE REFUSALS, RECORDED SO THEY ARE NOT RE-DERIVED. (1) The 1.09 g cm-3 buoyant density with a 30% dry-matter figure (Loferer-Krossbacher/Fagerbakke lineage) is a CELL buoyant density from density-gradient centrifugation of individual cells, while density_basis must be wet_bulk and a parcel bundles cells AND their extracellular material AND the interstitial water; it excludes the matrix and the pore water and overstates the bulk by roughly the void fraction. It is dimensionally plausible, widely cited, easy to justify in a sentence, and wrong. (2) The Frontiers Env Sci 2017 biofilm concentrations (cells 224 mM, bound EPS 168 mM, loosely associated EPS 56 mM at 113 g/mol from C5H7O2N) are cited to Nielsen 1997 and Laspidou & Rittmann 2002 — IMPORTED FROM PRIOR LITERATURE, NOT MEASURED ON THAT SYSTEM — so they are evidence_basis=declared, which sits in BLOCKED_EVIDENCE; the paper also measures within a 2 x 2 x 2 mm3 NMR voxel, three orders of magnitude coarser than any plausible lattice pitch. (3) Genome-scale metabolic model biomass objective functions, the only route located to an S. oneidensis elemental composition, are a declared stoichiometry frequently borrowed wholesale from E. coli, on a dry basis, failing both the evidence rule and the basis rule. density_g_cm3 STAYS BLANK, and blank means not measured.

column2: Search for a calibrated 3-D radiation-exposed biomass field for any of the seven modelled species
column4: Cryptococcus neoformans; Deinococcus radiodurans; Cladosporium sphaerospermum; Bacillus subtilis; Aspergillus niger; Shewanella oneidensis; Ochrobactrum intermedium AM7
column31: NO CANDIDATE FOUND, AND THIS IS THE CENTRAL FINDING OF THE AUDIT. Eleven repositories were queried at API level: Dryad, Zenodo, Figshare, EBI BioImage Archive, EBI BioStudies, IDR, EMPIAR, NASA OSDR, heiDATA, depositonce and MINDS@UW, plus NCBI GEO, BioProject, SRA and nuccore. ZERO VOLUMETRIC DEPOSITS EXIST for C. neoformans, C. sphaerospermum, A. niger, D. radiodurans, S. oneidensis or O. intermedium AM7 — for C. neoformans the emptiness was reproduced independently on three repository APIs (IDR returned 0 images/projects/screens/plates/wells; BioImage Archive returned totalHits 0 with isTotalHitsExact true; Dryad returned 8 datasets, none imaging). raw_3d_images is false on every radiation-exposed row in this ledger; there is no confocal z-stack, no calibrated volumetric segmentation and no parcel-compatible dynamic observable anywhere in the radiation literature for the seven species. Nothing anywhere describes the seven-species consortium under its declared conditions, and no single-species dataset can clear the target gate however good its data are. A RADIATION-EXPOSED 3-D BIOMASS FIELD FOR A TARGET SPECIES MUST BE ACQUIRED, NOT RETRIEVED: on one system under one growth condition, replicate-level wet and dry mass with matched hydrated and dry substrate blanks, a hydrated volume on a whole_biofilm_envelope basis or a declared pore_volume_fraction, ash content, CHNS plus ICP-OES/ICP-MS closing to 1 on a wet-bulk basis, a calibrated 3D stack of the same specimen, and a characterised dose field with a measured gradient.
